tools.name: get_known_responses
tools.description: Analyze an OpenAPI or Swagger document provided as a URL OR a raw JSON string or file contents, and list possible HTTP responses (status codes and descriptions) for the specified operation ID.

addressOrFileContents.description: URL address of the OpenAPI or Swagger JSON document OR raw JSON contents of the OpenAPI or Swagger specification. Can be provided as text or from a file.

operationId.description: Operation ID for which to retrieve known responses.

tools.name: generate_curl_command
tools.description: Generate a cURL command for a given operation ID from a URL OR a raw JSON string or file contents pointing to an OpenAPI or Swagger JSON document.

addressOrFileContents.description: URL address of the OpenAPI or Swagger JSON document OR raw JSON contents of the OpenAPI or Swagger specification. Can be provided as text or from a file.

operationId.description: Operation ID for which to generate the cURL command.

baseAddress.description: Optional base URL to be used in the generated cURL command.

tools.name: validate_document
tools.description: Analyze and validate an OpenAPI or Swagger document provided as a URL OR a raw JSON string or file contents, and list possible errors, issues and problems with specification for the specified operation ID.

addressOrFileContents.description: URL address of the OpenAPI or Swagger JSON document OR raw JSON contents of the OpenAPI or Swagger specification. Can be provided as text or from a file.

tools.name: create_csharp_snippet
tools.description: Generate a C# code snippet for a given operation ID from a URL OR a raw JSON string or file contents pointing to an OpenAPI or Swagger JSON document.

addressOrFileContents.description: URL address of the OpenAPI or Swagger JSON document OR raw JSON contents of the OpenAPI or Swagger specification. Can be provided as text or from a file.

operationId.description: Operation ID for which to create a snippet.

baseAddress.description: Optional base URL to be used in the generated cURL command.

tools.name: get_list_of_operations
tools.description: Retrieve a list of operations (endpoints) from a URL OR a raw JSON string or file contents pointing to an OpenAPI or Swagger JSON document.

addressOrFileContents.description: URL address of the OpenAPI or Swagger JSON document OR raw JSON contents of the OpenAPI or Swagger specification. Can be provided as text or from a file.
